errors.text_span: пет различни модели – CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT и един неидентифициран модел, представен с оранжев стълб
errors.evidence: The chart displays data for only four models (CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT), not five. The orange bar is explicitly labeled as 'CoD' in the legend, it is not an unidentified model.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос по дъното на диаграмата представя петте модели
errors.evidence: There is no horizontal axis at the bottom representing the models. The models are categories represented by the legend and their corresponding colored bars within two separate sections: 'Accuracy (%)' and 'Token Count'.

errors.text_span: Всяка категория има два стълба – един за точност и един за брой токените
errors.evidence: The chart is not structured as a grouped bar chart where each category has a pair of bars. Instead, it is divided into two main sections (Accuracy and Token Count), each containing four bars corresponding to the four different models.
The description incorrectly assigns the orange color to a fifth, non-existent model ('останалите' - the rest). The legend clearly shows that the orange color corresponds to the 'CoD' model.

errors.text_span: подредени в азбучен ред според техните имена
errors.evidence: The models are not ordered alphabetically. The order of the bars is CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT within each section, which is not alphabetical.

errors.text_span: across four language models (LRMs) on four benchmarks
errors.evidence: This information is derived from the paper's caption, not the visual content of the figure itself. The figure does not mention LRMs or benchmarks.
The description swaps the accuracy values for CoD and CoUT. According to the chart, CoD has an accuracy of 80.89% and CoUT has an accuracy of 88.40%.

errors.text_span: The bars are sorted in descending order of accuracy on the left side
errors.evidence: The bars on the left, representing accuracy, are not sorted in descending order. The values are 91.19, 80.89, 88.50, and 88.40.

errors.text_span: The bar chart, titled 'Accuracy (%)' and labeled 'Token Count' on the secondary y-axis
errors.evidence: The chart consists of two sub-plots, each with its own title: 'Accuracy (%)' and 'Token Count'. The description inaccurately presents 'Accuracy (%)' as the single title for the entire chart and 'Token Count' as a y-axis label rather than a title for the right-hand plot.

The description fails to clearly articulate the chart's structure, which consists of two separate sub-plots side-by-side: one for Accuracy and one for Token Count. It discusses the data from the 'left side' and 'right side' without first establishing this fundamental layout.

errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse stellt die Methoden dar, die in der Reihenfolge CoT, CoD, CCoT und CoUT angeordnet sind
errors.evidence: The chart is not organized along a horizontal axis of methods. It is divided into two distinct sections, "Accuracy (%)" and "Token Count". Within each section, there are four bars, one for each method.

errors.text_span: Jede Methode hat zwei Balken: der linke Balken repräsentiert die Genauigkeit, der rechte die Tokenanzahl.
errors.evidence: The chart does not show two bars per method. Instead, it displays two separate groups of four bars each. The first group shows the accuracy for all four methods, and the second group shows the token count for all four methods.
